steps.title: Topic Design Principles
steps.text: Good topic granularity follows domain boundaries. Avoid topics that are too coarse (mixed types) or too fine (per-entity). Group by domain aggregate for the right balance.

steps.title: Partitioning Trade-offs
steps.text: Choose partition keys based on your ordering and scalability needs. Entity IDs give per-entity ordering, while random keys maximize throughput at the cost of ordering.

steps.title: Schema Evolution
steps.text: Plan for schema changes from the start. Use backward compatibility (new consumers read old data) and forward compatibility (old consumers read new data) strategies.

steps.title: Event-Driven Patterns
steps.text: Apply CQRS to separate read and write models through Surgewave topics. Use Event Sourcing to make the event log the source of truth, with projections for query-optimized views.

steps.title: Decision Framework
steps.text: When designing your architecture, ask five key questions: domain boundaries, ordering guarantees, schema evolution, read patterns, and expected scale.
